The Dawnguard radiant parent quest has a 'Help Sorine with her project to improve the crossbow' objective and a Sorine alias, and this quest has its own start node; the dialogue that hands it out and what must happen first aren't in these files.

The quest has aliases named EnhancedCrossbow, DwarvenCrossbow, EnhancedDwarvenCrossbow and BoltFire/Ice/Shock, but these files don't say what fills them or whether you get any of them. LoreRim's forge recipes for the Improved Dawnguard Crossbow, Dwemer Crossbow, Improved Dwemer Crossbow and the fire bolts/arrows check four Dawnguard globals, but the extract shows each check as the global equalling 0, which read literally means open until the global changes, not unlocked by it. What this quest actually hands over or unlocks needs the quest script (and the recipe conditions' raw flags).
The records place Sorine in Fort Dawnguard; her daily schedule isn't in these files.
The ruin and the item are filled when the quest starts, so they change from game to game.

The quest has five BanditScrap aliases and a BanditLetter alias that holds the book Dwarven Haul; no objective or log mentions bandits, so whether you meet any, or what the scraps and letter are for, isn't shown.
The quest is a Dawnguard (vampire hunter) job, so it belongs to the hunter side, but the exact condition that opens the radiant jobs isn't in these files.
